features.name: Write-path preserves all element kinds
features.description: write_mtlx must serialize the generic nodes bucket (nodedef/typedef/look/propertyset/plain node instances), not just materials/node_graphs, so nothing is destroyed on write.

features.name: Real graph connection resolution
features.description: Turn nodename/interfacename string references into actual traversable edges (name->node index), not inert strings.

features.name: Node category (not just data-type) tracking
features.description: Fix node-type histogram to report the node's function/category, not its data type.

features.name: volumematerial and legacy shaderref/bindinput
features.description: Recognize volumematerial and older shaderref/bindinput material forms, not just surfacematerial.
